source: [D] #145 signer column. The existing RuleSet schema: spec is the node's control verdict, engine is the node's SDK verdict, column is the signing method, native holds measured scriptCode/digest predicates. Control refusals are not signer disagreements. Counts include only actual node judgments.

sighash.scriptcode.in-unlock.lock-only.decided_by: [SRC] bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 6504a3af src/script/interpreter.cpp:1471-1506 forms the unlock tail plus locking script after Chronicle, and refuses an incorrect signature. Before Chronicle it uses the unlock tail alone. [SRC] @bsv/sdk 3.0.0 script/templates/P2PKH.ts:77-100 resolves the template's locking script through script/templates/SignatureUtils.ts:140-158, and SignatureUtils.ts:199-213 passes that lock as subscript. The adapter's api-default method mirrors this lock selection at harness/engines/ts/signer.mjs:210-218 and supplies it as subscript at :122. primitives/TransactionSignature.ts:262 and :394-396 serialize the supplied subscript; the formatter does not derive the in-unlock scriptCode. TypeScript lines are the pinned package source map sourcesContent.
sighash.scriptcode.in-unlock.lock-only.note: The adapter's api-default mode explicitly supplies the prevout locking script to TransactionSignature.format. The formatter uses the supplied subscript; it does not derive scriptCode for an in-unlock CHECKSIG. Supplying the corpus scriptCode makes these measured rows valid. No in-unlock template was exercised at this pin.

sighash.single.out-of-range.one.decided_by: [SRC] bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 6504a3af src/script/interpreter.cpp:2086-2100 returns uint256 one when SINGLE's input index is beyond the outputs; :2112-2124 selects this original digest for CHRONICLE. [SRC] @bsv/sdk 3.0.0 script/templates/SignatureUtils.ts:199-213 supplies lockingScript as subscript; script/templates/P2PKH.ts:102-130 hashes and signs the formatted preimage; primitives/TransactionSignature.ts:254-365 serializes the original transaction and :425-440 dispatches to it. Lines are the pinned package source map sourcesContent.
sighash.single.out-of-range.one.note: The SDK signs the hash of its full original serialization where the node verifies constant one. Classified only after the node refuses the SDK and accepts the hand-signed control. A no-FORKID row refused on encoding alone is a control refusal, not evidence of this digest divergence.

corpus.control.sigpushonly.note: The corpus deliberately places a non-push unlock under a word/version requiring push-only. Both the SDK and hand-signed control must have this exact reject token. This is counted apart from signer divergences.

rows.why: A valid control and a refused default signature at an in-unlock site, with a measured lock-only scriptCode and unequal digest.

The control digest is constant one for SINGLE and differs from the SDK digest; the node accepts the control and refuses the SDK.
The corpus deliberately places a non-push unlock under a word/version requiring push-only. Both sides must give the same token.
